slides.lead: Once people use your app, the ideas start coming. Here's how to not drown.
One list. Same place every time. Don't trust your memory.
"Add a chat" might mean "I can't reach anyone." Solve that, not the request.
One loud person is one person. Five quiet ones asking the same thing is a signal.
If it doesn't make the main thing better, it waits. Even if it's a good idea.
"Not right now, here's why" keeps people around. Silence doesn't.

slides.h2: Listen to everyone. Build for the pattern.
